top_stories.title: Microsoft launches $99 Microsoft 365 E7 with AI-powered Copilot Cowork
top_stories.summary: Microsoft has announced a $99 ‘Microsoft 365 E7’ subscription, bundling new Copilot Cowork AI features with expanded business app integrations. The move expands Copilot's role as a digital assistant and signals Microsoft's push to mainstream AI-powered productivity tools for enterprises.

top_stories.title: Microsoft introduces Microsoft 365 E7 subscription with expanded AI features
top_stories.summary: Microsoft's new E7 subscription introduces expanded AI features for business users, building on its Copilot offerings. The launch represents Microsoft's increased focus on agentic AI to automate more workflows across the Microsoft 365 suite.

top_stories.title: Microsoft announces Copilot Cowork with help from Anthropic — a cloud-powered AI agent that works across M365 apps
top_stories.summary: Microsoft has unveiled Copilot Cowork, a new AI agent developed in collaboration with Anthropic that can work across Microsoft 365 apps, aiming to enhance collaboration and productivity for enterprise users.

top_stories.title: Learnings from paying artists royalties for AI-generated art
top_stories.summary: Kapwing shares insights from its experiment compensating artists when their images are used in AI-generated content, highlighting the challenges and potential frameworks for fair remuneration in AI and IP.
